name: @map-harness/spatial-realtime
description: Realtime spatial stream contracts: the versioned `spatial-realtime@1` StreamSpec binding event time / ingest time / process time, event-id deduplication, watermarks and tumbling windows with bounded late-event revisions, a controlled pull-based scenario source with disconnect/reconnect and intake backpressure, and checkpoint/resume with immutable materialized window revisions. A pure library the stream tools consume — no host row.
